# **ADCOTE™**: One Global Brand for Flexible Materials

**The Right Performance. Right Where You Are.**

Bostik unifies its laminating adhesives and coatings portfolio under ADCOTE™, delivering reliable,
fit‑for‑purpose solutions worldwide.

[ Explore the portfolio ][65]
[Bostik ADCOTE™ visual showing a flexible packaging pouch representing adhesives and coatings
solutions for flexible materials.] Bostik ADCOTE™ visual showing a flexible packaging pouch
representing adhesives and coatings solutions for flexible materials.

# Recognized innovation powering the future of hygiene

Bostik has been honored at the INDEX™ 26 Awards for Kizen® Miles 9.0, a breakthrough adhesive
designed to advance both performance and sustainability in hygiene applications. By enabling
efficient material separation at end-of-life and incorporating renewable content, this innovation
supports the development of high-performing products aligned with circular economy goals.

[ Discover the innovation ][66]
[A person holding an open plastic food container filled with fresh blueberries outdoors, with a
glowing edge highlighting the packaging.] A person holding an open plastic food container filled
with fresh blueberries outdoors, with a glowing edge highlighting the packaging.

# Empowering **local communities** to create lasting impact

Bostik proudly launches its Community Grant Programme to empower impactful local initiatives around
the world. By supporting community organizations and local partners, the programme helps bring
sustainable, meaningful projects to life, strengthening connections, fostering collaboration, and
creating lasting positive change where it matters most.

[ Discover the programme ][67]
[A Bostik representative addressing a group of participants during a community event held outdoors.]

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

Adhesives are materials that join two surfaces together, typically by creating a bond. The use of
adhesives dates back to prehistoric times when early humans used natural adhesives like tree resin
and animal hide glue to make tools and weapons. Over time, adhesives became more sophisticated, and
new materials and formulations were developed. For example, the ancient Egyptians used animal glue
and beeswax to bind papyrus scrolls, while the Romans used a mixture of lime and volcanic ash to
make cement. [Read More…][49]

Adhesives The term “adhesives” applies to a wide variety of substances that, when applied, binds one
or more flat surfaces together. Types of binding that adhesives provide include sealing, bonding,
and laminating, both permanent and temporary. Adhesives can also waterproof and level surfaces, trap
liquids, and fill holes and seams. Adhesives are made through the combination of an epoxy resin and
a hardening substance, called a curing mechanism.

Because of their fast cure time and strong adhesive bonds, cyanoacrylates are ideal for use in
maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) applications. They enable users to create durable and

consistency. Please contact for more information.

Whether you are manufacturing vinyl windows, poly plantation shutters, installing complex crown
moulding trim, refurbishing a bridge or manufacturing an electric guitar, there is a cyanoacrylate
that can be formulated to meet your specific needs. Please contact for more information.

[Learn More][73]

Cyanoacrylates are used for load-bearing medical equipment such as the bottoms of crutches, canes,
walkers, cast boots, and surgical instruments. In addition, cyanoacrylates are widely used as an
adhesive for medical equipment and devices that require a reliable bond. Please contact for more
information.

[Learn More][74]

Cyanoacrylates offer strong, instant cures and bond easily to a variety of surfaces. These
properties make them well-suited for use in industrial assembly operations. Please contact for more
information.

[Learn More][75]

Cyanoacrylates are used during the plastic assembly process whenever similar or dissimilar plastic
parts need to form a permanent, contact-based connection. Please contact for more information.

[Learn More][76]

Cyanoacrylates are used for speaker voice coil, cone and surround assembly, vacuum cleaner
subcomponent assembly, nylon strain relief on vinyl power cord, windings on motor, control knobs,
metal laminating of transformer cores. Please contact for more information.

[Learn More][77]

substrates to other substrates in the manufacturing process. Benefits include high peel strength,
excellent bond retention after exposure to temperatures as high as 250 F, rapid fixturing times and
cure speeds, and bonding low surface energy rubber with the use of surface treatment primers. Reach

serving industries across the USA. The company was established by Ed Brozynski and Terry Cassidy,

strengthened in 2006 when John Mahoney, a seasoned professional with more than 20 years of adhesive
experience, joined the team. Together, this trio of experts has built BC Adhesives into one of the

support and exceptional service to businesses nationwide.

## Biz Kimiz?

1988 yılında bir aile şirketi olarak kurulan Frimpeks, dünya çapında 9 farklı yerleşkede serüvenine
devam ediyor. Avrupa kıtasında Türkiye, Almanya, Birleşik Krallık, Rusya Federasyonu ve Amerika
kıtasında ise Amerika Birleşik Devletleri'nde kurulu üretim tesislerimiz ve satış
organizasyonlarımız bulunmaktadır.

## Ne Yapıyoruz?

30 yılı aşkın kimya ve baskı endüstrisindeki üretim tecrübemizle ürettiğimiz Kendinden Yapışkanlı
Ürünler (Kendinden Yapışkanlı Etiketler, Grafik Ürünleri ve Çözümleri), Mürekkepler ve Laklar (UV
ile kürlenen ve Su-bazlı), Endüstriyel Yapıştırıcılar (Esnek Ambalaj, Reaktif Poliüretan HotMelt,
Sıvı Poliüretan, Su-bazlı Akrilik ve PVA), Endüstriyel Kaplama Kimyasalları (Ahşap, Cam ve Plastik)
ürün yelpazemizle birçok sektöre kesintisiz ve en iyi şekilde hizmet verebilmek için var gücümüzle
çalışmaktayız.

organizasyonlarımız bulunmaktadır.

Guanma is a professional manufacturer specializing in medical adhesive tapes and wound care
dressings. With a strong foundation in pressure sensitive adhesive (PSA) coating technology, we

various clinical and surgical requirements. Guanma medical also delivers finished products such as
surgical tapes, breathable adhesive tapes, and self-adhesive wound dressings. We strives to be your
reliable partner in medical tape manufacturing and wound care product supply.

# ITW Global Fasteners – Innovative fasteners for the automotive sector

## ITW Global Fasteners hold cars together. We develop, produce and market intelligent and
## innovative fastening solutions for the automotive industry. We aim to provide solutions that are
## lightweight, cost effective and easy to install, while also ensuring reliable and durable
## connections. As part of ITW Automotive, we can rely on the experience gained from a hundred years
## of history, and use this experience for every new development. We listen closely, think
## creatively and work proactively. Together with you, we work to solve the most pressing challenges
## you are experiencing today and develop sustainable solutions for the needs of tomorrow. That is
## how we help to make mobility fit for the future.

## Propulsion EV

Multifunctional components for Evs.
ITW products master special requirements such as electrical insulation, light weight and corrosion
resistance.

Comfort and safety in vehicle interiors.

Precisely organizing technology.

Well-managed lines.

# Innovative fastening solutions from ITW Global Fasteners

## ITW Global Fasteners constantly works for and with customers to develop clever and efficient
## fasteners made from plastic and metal. Our goal is to ensure simple and secure connections. ITW
## fasteners can be fitted and removed without the need for special tools – or any tools at all.
## When we develop products, we always focus on the needs of the future. That is why we value
## ergonomic installation, resistance to wear and external influences, high holding force, light
## weight, versatility and reusability. Take a look at our latest developments.

## **TORSION CLIP**

### The clip you can use again and again.
### This product replaces nuts and bolts, making attaching and removing chassis components much
### easier. The Torsion Clip is simply pushed into place, and can then be later removed easily and
### gently with a screwdriver.

## **SCREWLESS LUGGAGE RING**

### Our screwless luggage rings are designed to hold heavy loads without any screws. They are simply
### pushed into the corresponding hole in the metal. Once the protective cap is sealed, it sits
### securely. To remove, simply open the protective cap and remove the ring.

# Achieving success together

## In our team, everyone can contribute their expertise. That is why we work in three specialized
## divisions: European Regional Accounts, European Global Accounts and European Metal Fasteners.

At JiuJu New Materials, our proprietary** dry-process modification technology** boosts thermal

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

# **THE **EXPERTISE**  TO SOLVE…**

# **THE **PASSION**  TO SERVE.**

### There's a better way to bond.


At RS Industrial, we are dedicated to helping manufacturers and distributors have peace of mind when
they send product out the door. Our team passionately works alongside you and see ourselves as an
extension of your company. We have been faithfully delivering adhesive solutions for the world’s
sticky situations for almost 30 years. Contact us to discover a better way to bond.

[

### TECHNICAL EXPERTISE

][35]

Our technical team joins customers in the field or analyzes products at our in-house lab to gather
vital information on your gluing needs. We also help implement and train your team to give you the
tools for success.

[

### CUSTOMER-FOCUSED CARE

][36]

From emergency shipments, customized labeling, or 24/7 live customer service, our customers know
they can count on us to help on sunny and rainy days.

## Resource Center

We deliver hands-on adhesive tips, guides and resources designed to help engineers solve their
manufacturing challenges.

[

### Troubleshooting

][37]

Guides focused on how to troubleshoot hot melt failures, labeling messes, proper cleaning procedures
for waterbased adhesives.

[View Guides][38]
[

### Instructional Videos

][39]
Watch videos designed to teach you to use a wet mil gauge or a bead width calculator so you can
control your adhesive consumption.
[Watch Videos][40]
[

### Industry-Specific Resources

][41]
Learn more about how an adhesive affects your process in case and carton sealing, product assembly,
labeling or bookbinding.
[View Resources][42]

###### ENSURING YOUR PROCESSES ARE OPTIMAL

## Offering an extensive line of hot melts, waterbased, double-sided tapes and stuctural adhesives.

Not only do we distribute adhesives, we **manufacture** them, too. Our full selection of industrial
adhesives has been designed to provide solutions for **[a wide range of markets][43]**, which
includes **general packaging, product assembly, labeling, contract packaging and more**. We have
developed multiple brands for a comprehensive line of adhesives that are of equal or higher quality
than most national brands. All products have been value tested and performance screened by
our** [in-house lab facility][44]**, ensuring our customers the **best competitive solution
available**.

###### CUSTOMER-FOCUSED, PERFORMANCE-DRIVEN**
###### **

## Providing hands-on adhesive support.

Our customer service team is **available around the clock 24/7** to ensure you get what you need,
when you need it. We know how frustrating it can be to reach an automated machine or directory when
you contact your supplier. That’s why you’ll immediately **speak to a live, experienced
representative** when you contact us. Our representatives are trained to answer your questions
and provide **one-on-one support**.

[Read More About Us][45]

## Why use anonymous Instagram viewer?

Instagram is one of the most popular social networks in the world. Millions of people share their
lives daily, but sometimes you want to stay invisible while keeping an eye on someone’s stories or
updates. That’s exactly what our anonymous viewer allows you to do — safely, privately, and without
restrictions.

Whether you’re tracking public accounts, researching trends, following celebrities, or just curious,
this tool helps you view stories without anyone knowing. You can browse, preview, and even download
posts in high quality, all without needing your own Instagram login.

The system works in real time — once you enter the username, you immediately get access to the
latest stories, photos, videos, and highlights available on that account. Enjoy seamless, secure
browsing powered by privacy-first technology.

## How it works

##### 1. Enter username

Type the Instagram name or paste a link in the search bar.

##### 2. Stay anonymous

Browse stories and posts without leaving any trace.

##### 3. Save content

Download stories, videos, and photos in one click.

## Powerful Features for Private Viewing

Discover the core features that make **Story Navigation** the most advanced and secure Instagram
viewer. Every element of our platform is built with privacy, speed, and usability in mind.

##### Anonymous Story Viewing

Watch Instagram stories and reels without leaving any trace — your name never appears in view lists.

##### Instant Downloads

Save stories, photos, and videos directly to your device in original quality — with one click.

##### Privacy Protection

No login, no cookies, no tracking. Your identity and IP remain fully hidden at all times.

##### Fast & Lightweight

Our system is optimized for speed — instant loading, smooth animations, and zero lag.

##### Worldwide Access

Access public Instagram content from anywhere in the world. No region restrictions or VPN required.

###### At The Liquid Nails, we are passionate about providing high-quality adhesives that keep
###### projects and dreams together. Since our founding over 50 years ago, we have been dedicated to

## About Liquid Nails

Liquid Nails is the #1 brand of premium-grade adhesives and gel nail products in the United States.
For over 50 years, contractors, remodelers, automotive enthusiasts and DIYers have trusted Liquid
Nails to complete projects efficiently and achieve lasting bonds.

It all started in 1967 when founder Harry W. Coover Jr. discovered a unique latex-based formula that
created incredibly strong yet flexible adhesive bonds on various surfaces from wood and drywall to
concrete and metal. Liquid Nails quickly revolutionized the construction industry with its ease of
use, versatility and reliability.

Today, Liquid Nails continues to lead the market through ongoing innovation in advanced bonding
technologies. Our extensive product line includes targeted solutions for demanding construction jobs
as well as home repairs, automotive fixes, nail art enhancements and more.

With dedicated R&D and rigorous quality control, Liquid Nails ensures every product lives up to our
brand promise – to empower professionals and DIYers to complete projects more efficiently, achieving
lasting bonds they can trust. Discover why millions have built success with Liquid Nails.

particular materials and applications – whether for subflooring, millwork, plastic, fiberglass,
masonry, automotive repairs or at-home nail enhancements.

#### Innovating Since 1967

Liquid Nails has led the industry in adhesive technology for over 50 years. Our longstanding
expertise and innovation ensures you’re getting cutting-edge formulations that provide a competitive
advantage.

#### Excellent Customer Satisfaction

In addition to quality adhesives, Liquid Nails provides helpful project advice and support. Our goal
is giving you the tools and knowledge for project success.

We are AFINITICA, we produce the most advanced instant adhesives in the world.

We develop revolutionary hi-technology adhesives for professional, industrial and consumer markets.
We are the first

cyanoacrylate adhesives.

Our adhesives are designed for the consumer, professional craftsmen, industrial, biomedical and
cosmetic markets. Through our products we open up new applications and new opportunities to improve
efficiency, performance and user experience.

convenience". Ciaran McArdle - CTO of Afinitica

Who we are
We are AFINITICA, we produce the most advanced instant adhesives in the world.

We develop revolutionary hi-technology adhesives for professional, industrial and consumer markets.
We are the first
and only company to design cyanoacrylate solutions to address every possible need.

We are the first company with a dedicated focus on instant adhesives. Our team comprises an eclectic
mix of talents with a shared passion to grow business and create new possibilities in the area of
cyanoacrylate adhesives.

Our adhesives are designed for the consumer, professional craftsmen, industrial, biomedical and
cosmetic markets. Through our products we open up new applications and new opportunities to improve
efficiency, performance and user experience.

"Simply put - we wish to transform the profile of the materials we are passionate about from the
status of simple superglues to the adhesive of choice for performance, sustainability and
convenience". Ciaran McArdle - CTO of Afinitica

## ABOUT US

Guangdong YRBEST High Polymer Technology Co., Ltd was founded in 2014 by senior technical experts
from well-known adhesive companies in Germany, Japan, China, and other countries

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

Adhesives are materials that join two surfaces together, typically by creating a bond. The use of
adhesives dates back to prehistoric times when early humans used natural adhesives like tree resin
and animal hide glue to make tools and weapons. Over time, adhesives became more sophisticated, and
new materials and formulations were developed. For example, the ancient Egyptians used animal glue
and beeswax to bind papyrus scrolls, while the Romans used a mixture of lime and volcanic ash to
make cement. [Read More…][49]

Adhesives The term “adhesives” applies to a wide variety of substances that, when applied, binds one
or more flat surfaces together. Types of binding that adhesives provide include sealing, bonding,
and laminating, both permanent and temporary. Adhesives can also waterproof and level surfaces, trap
liquids, and fill holes and seams. Adhesives are made through the combination of an epoxy resin and
a hardening substance, called a curing mechanism.

## AUTOMOTIVE & AEROSPACE

Adhesives and foams improve safety, NVH performance, and fuel efficiency in automotive and
aerospace. Lightweight foams provide insulation and cushioning, while advanced adhesives create
durable, reliable bonds, reducing weight and boosting comfort and sustainability.

[packaging]

insulation. In construction, adhesives enhance structural integrity, complemented by foams that
improve thermal efficiency and soundproofing. Together, these technologies enhance performance and
reduce costs.

maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) applications. They enable users to create durable and

moulding trim, refurbishing a bridge or manufacturing an electric guitar, there is a cyanoacrylate
that can be formulated to meet your specific needs. Please contact for more information.

[Learn More][73]

Cyanoacrylates are used for load-bearing medical equipment such as the bottoms of crutches, canes,
walkers, cast boots, and surgical instruments. In addition, cyanoacrylates are widely used as an
adhesive for medical equipment and devices that require a reliable bond. Please contact for more
information.

[Learn More][74]

Cyanoacrylates offer strong, instant cures and bond easily to a variety of surfaces. These
properties make them well-suited for use in industrial assembly operations. Please contact for more
information.

[Learn More][75]

Cyanoacrylates are used during the plastic assembly process whenever similar or dissimilar plastic
parts need to form a permanent, contact-based connection. Please contact for more information.

[Learn More][76]

Cyanoacrylates are used for speaker voice coil, cone and surround assembly, vacuum cleaner
subcomponent assembly, nylon strain relief on vinyl power cord, windings on motor, control knobs,
metal laminating of transformer cores. Please contact for more information.

#### Adhesives

Sealants are used to block the penetration of liquids, dust, and other contaminants by creating an

UV Curing adhesives, coatings, maskants and encapsulants are environmentally friendly and cure at

Encapsulants / Potting Compounds protect the circuit from thermal and mechanical stresses and
provide electrical insulation for high voltages.

lengths, and threads.

## Biz Kimiz?

1988 yılında bir aile şirketi olarak kurulan Frimpeks, dünya çapında 9 farklı yerleşkede serüvenine
devam ediyor. Avrupa kıtasında Türkiye, Almanya, Birleşik Krallık, Rusya Federasyonu ve Amerika
kıtasında ise Amerika Birleşik Devletleri'nde kurulu üretim tesislerimiz ve satış
organizasyonlarımız bulunmaktadır.

## Ne Yapıyoruz?

30 yılı aşkın kimya ve baskı endüstrisindeki üretim tecrübemizle ürettiğimiz Kendinden Yapışkanlı
Ürünler (Kendinden Yapışkanlı Etiketler, Grafik Ürünleri ve Çözümleri), Mürekkepler ve Laklar (UV
ile kürlenen ve Su-bazlı), Endüstriyel Yapıştırıcılar (Esnek Ambalaj, Reaktif Poliüretan HotMelt,
Sıvı Poliüretan, Su-bazlı Akrilik ve PVA), Endüstriyel Kaplama Kimyasalları (Ahşap, Cam ve Plastik)
ürün yelpazemizle birçok sektöre kesintisiz ve en iyi şekilde hizmet verebilmek için var gücümüzle
çalışmaktayız.

[Daha Fazla Bilgi İçin][47]

## Nerelerdeyiz

1988 yılında Türkiye'de başlayan serüvenimize dünya üzerindeki birçok sektörde (ör. Yiyecek ve
İçecek, Lojistik ve Taşımacılık, Kişisel Bakım, Perakende, Petrol, Kimya, Otomotiv, Mobilya, Cam,
Plastik, Paketleme ve Dijital Medya, vb.) aktif olan müşterilerimize eksiksiz hizmet verebilmek için
Türkiye'deki 4 noktamıza ek olarak Avrupa kıtasında Almanya, Birleşik Krallık, Rusya Federasyonu;
Amerika kıtasında ise Amerika Birleşik Devletleri olmak üzere toplam 9 farklı yerleşkede devam
etmekteyiz.

# ITW Global Fasteners – Innovative fasteners for the automotive sector

## ITW Global Fasteners hold cars together. We develop, produce and market intelligent and
## innovative fastening solutions for the automotive industry. We aim to provide solutions that are
## lightweight, cost effective and easy to install, while also ensuring reliable and durable
## connections. As part of ITW Automotive, we can rely on the experience gained from a hundred years
## of history, and use this experience for every new development. We listen closely, think
## creatively and work proactively. Together with you, we work to solve the most pressing challenges
## you are experiencing today and develop sustainable solutions for the needs of tomorrow. That is
## how we help to make mobility fit for the future.

## Propulsion EV

Multifunctional components for Evs.
ITW products master special requirements such as electrical insulation, light weight and corrosion
resistance.
[Discover degassing valves and more][39]

## Interior

Comfort and safety in vehicle interiors.
Our interior fasteners are easy to install and offer high holding force.
[Discover clips and more][40]

## Exterior

Secure fasteners and stoppers.
You can rely on our reliable, low-maintenance and noise-insulating exterior elements.
[Discover stoppers and more][41]

## Body & Chassis

Secure, protect, seal.
We offer solutions for chassis and bodywork that extend vehicles’ longevity.
[Discover plugs and more][42]

## Electrical Routing

Precisely organizing technology.
We ensure tidy cable and wire management with innovative solutions and modern multi-component
systems.
[Discover cable fasteners and more][43]

## Fluid & Air Routing

Well-managed lines.
Our experts work together with you to develop the most efficient ways of routing air and fluids.
[Discover pipe clips and more][44]

# Innovative fastening solutions from ITW Global Fasteners

## ITW Global Fasteners constantly works for and with customers to develop clever and efficient
## fasteners made from plastic and metal. Our goal is to ensure simple and secure connections. ITW
## fasteners can be fitted and removed without the need for special tools – or any tools at all.
## When we develop products, we always focus on the needs of the future. That is why we value
## ergonomic installation, resistance to wear and external influences, high holding force, light
## weight, versatility and reusability. Take a look at our latest developments.

## **TORSION CLIP**

### The clip you can use again and again.
### This product replaces nuts and bolts, making attaching and removing chassis components much
### easier. The Torsion Clip is simply pushed into place, and can then be later removed easily and
### gently with a screwdriver.

## **SCREWLESS LUGGAGE RING**

### Our screwless luggage rings are designed to hold heavy loads without any screws. They are simply
### pushed into the corresponding hole in the metal. Once the protective cap is sealed, it sits
### securely. To remove, simply open the protective cap and remove the ring.

# Achieving success together

## In our team, everyone can contribute their expertise. That is why we work in three specialized
## divisions: European Regional Accounts, European Global Accounts and European Metal Fasteners.
## Together, we are a successful company.

# **THE **EXPERTISE**  TO SOLVE…**

# **THE **PASSION**  TO SERVE.**

### There's a better way to bond.


At RS Industrial, we are dedicated to helping manufacturers and distributors have peace of mind when
they send product out the door. Our team passionately works alongside you and see ourselves as an
extension of your company. We have been faithfully delivering adhesive solutions for the world’s
sticky situations for almost 30 years. Contact us to discover a better way to bond.

[

### TECHNICAL EXPERTISE

][35]

Our technical team joins customers in the field or analyzes products at our in-house lab to gather
vital information on your gluing needs. We also help implement and train your team to give you the
tools for success.

[

### CUSTOMER-FOCUSED CARE

][36]

From emergency shipments, customized labeling, or 24/7 live customer service, our customers know
they can count on us to help on sunny and rainy days.

## Resource Center

We deliver hands-on adhesive tips, guides and resources designed to help engineers solve their
manufacturing challenges.

[

### Troubleshooting

][37]

Guides focused on how to troubleshoot hot melt failures, labeling messes, proper cleaning procedures
for waterbased adhesives.

[View Guides][38]
[

### Instructional Videos

][39]
Watch videos designed to teach you to use a wet mil gauge or a bead width calculator so you can
control your adhesive consumption.
[Watch Videos][40]
[

### Industry-Specific Resources

][41]
Learn more about how an adhesive affects your process in case and carton sealing, product assembly,
labeling or bookbinding.
[View Resources][42]

###### ENSURING YOUR PROCESSES ARE OPTIMAL

## Offering an extensive line of hot melts, waterbased, double-sided tapes and stuctural adhesives.

Not only do we distribute adhesives, we **manufacture** them, too. Our full selection of industrial
adhesives has been designed to provide solutions for **[a wide range of markets][43]**, which
includes **general packaging, product assembly, labeling, contract packaging and more**. We have
developed multiple brands for a comprehensive line of adhesives that are of equal or higher quality
than most national brands. All products have been value tested and performance screened by
our** [in-house lab facility][44]**, ensuring our customers the **best competitive solution
available**.

###### CUSTOMER-FOCUSED, PERFORMANCE-DRIVEN**
###### **

## Providing hands-on adhesive support.

Our customer service team is **available around the clock 24/7** to ensure you get what you need,
when you need it. We know how frustrating it can be to reach an automated machine or directory when
you contact your supplier. That’s why you’ll immediately **speak to a live, experienced
representative** when you contact us. Our representatives are trained to answer your questions
and provide **one-on-one support**.

[Read More About Us][45]

## Why use anonymous Instagram viewer?

Instagram is one of the most popular social networks in the world. Millions of people share their
lives daily, but sometimes you want to stay invisible while keeping an eye on someone’s stories or
updates. That’s exactly what our anonymous viewer allows you to do — safely, privately, and without
restrictions.

Whether you’re tracking public accounts, researching trends, following celebrities, or just curious,
this tool helps you view stories without anyone knowing. You can browse, preview, and even download
posts in high quality, all without needing your own Instagram login.

The system works in real time — once you enter the username, you immediately get access to the
latest stories, photos, videos, and highlights available on that account. Enjoy seamless, secure
browsing powered by privacy-first technology.

## How it works

##### 1. Enter username

Type the Instagram name or paste a link in the search bar.

##### 2. Stay anonymous

Browse stories and posts without leaving any trace.

##### 3. Save content

Download stories, videos, and photos in one click.

## Powerful Features for Private Viewing

Discover the core features that make **Story Navigation** the most advanced and secure Instagram
viewer. Every element of our platform is built with privacy, speed, and usability in mind.

##### Anonymous Story Viewing

Watch Instagram stories and reels without leaving any trace — your name never appears in view lists.

##### Instant Downloads

Save stories, photos, and videos directly to your device in original quality — with one click.

##### Privacy Protection

No login, no cookies, no tracking. Your identity and IP remain fully hidden at all times.

##### Fast & Lightweight

Our system is optimized for speed — instant loading, smooth animations, and zero lag.

##### Worldwide Access

Access public Instagram content from anywhere in the world. No region restrictions or VPN required.

###### At The Liquid Nails, we are passionate about providing high-quality adhesives that keep
###### projects and dreams together. Since our founding over 50 years ago, we have been dedicated to

## About Liquid Nails

Liquid Nails is the #1 brand of premium-grade adhesives and gel nail products in the United States.
For over 50 years, contractors, remodelers, automotive enthusiasts and DIYers have trusted Liquid
Nails to complete projects efficiently and achieve lasting bonds.

It all started in 1967 when founder Harry W. Coover Jr. discovered a unique latex-based formula that
created incredibly strong yet flexible adhesive bonds on various surfaces from wood and drywall to
concrete and metal. Liquid Nails quickly revolutionized the construction industry with its ease of
use, versatility and reliability.

Today, Liquid Nails continues to lead the market through ongoing innovation in advanced bonding
technologies. Our extensive product line includes targeted solutions for demanding construction jobs
as well as home repairs, automotive fixes, nail art enhancements and more.

With dedicated R&D and rigorous quality control, Liquid Nails ensures every product lives up to our
brand promise – to empower professionals and DIYers to complete projects more efficiently, achieving
lasting bonds they can trust. Discover why millions have built success with Liquid Nails.

particular materials and applications – whether for subflooring, millwork, plastic, fiberglass,

expertise and innovation ensures you’re getting cutting-edge formulations that provide a competitive
advantage.

#### Excellent Customer Satisfaction

In addition to quality adhesives, Liquid Nails provides helpful project advice and support. Our goal

We are AFINITICA, we produce the most advanced instant adhesives in the world.

We develop revolutionary hi-technology adhesives for professional, industrial and consumer markets.
We are the first

cyanoacrylate adhesives.

Our adhesives are designed for the consumer, professional craftsmen, industrial, biomedical and
cosmetic markets. Through our products we open up new applications and new opportunities to improve
efficiency, performance and user experience.

convenience". Ciaran McArdle - CTO of Afinitica

We are AFINITICA, we produce the most advanced instant adhesives in the world.

We develop revolutionary hi-technology adhesives for professional, industrial and consumer markets.
We are the first
and only company to design cyanoacrylate solutions to address every possible need.

We are the first company with a dedicated focus on instant adhesives. Our team comprises an eclectic
mix of talents with a shared passion to grow business and create new possibilities in the area of
cyanoacrylate adhesives.

cosmetic markets. Through our products we open up new applications and new opportunities to improve
efficiency, performance and user experience.

status of simple superglues to the adhesive of choice for performance, sustainability and
convenience". Ciaran McArdle - CTO of Afinitica

## ABOUT US

Guangdong YRBEST High Polymer Technology Co., Ltd was founded in 2014 by senior technical experts
from well-known adhesive companies in Germany, Japan, China, and other countries
